faq.title: Your Question Answered
faq.subtitle: Have questions about Solaris Energy? Here are some of the most common queries to help you get started.

helpCard.title: Need More Help?
helpCard.text: Have questions about solar installation, pricing, or maintenance? Our experts are ready to assist.

faqs.question: What solar services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We provide end-to-end solar solutions: site assessment, custom system design, permitting, professional installation, smart monitoring, and ongoing maintenance for homes and businesses.

faqs.question: How much can I save with solar panels?
faqs.answer: Most customers cut their electricity bills by 50–70%, depending on system size, roof orientation, local rates and usage. Your consultation includes a detailed savings estimate.

faqs.question: How long does solar installation take?
faqs.answer: A typical residential installation takes 1–3 days on site. From first consultation to activation, the full process usually takes 4–8 weeks including permits and utility approval.

faqs.question: Do solar panels work during cloudy weather?
faqs.answer: Yes. Panels still generate electricity on cloudy days at reduced output. Modern high-efficiency panels capture diffuse light, and net metering or storage balances the difference.

faqs.question: How long do solar panels last?
faqs.answer: Quality solar panels last 25–30+ years and come with a 25-year performance warranty, degrading only slightly each year.

faqs.question: Do you offer system maintenance and support?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer monitoring, routine inspections, cleaning and prompt repair support so your system keeps performing at its best.
